questions.q: What condition causes the Loss_Reason_Required_When_Closed_Lost rule to block a save?
options: The Opportunity has no Products attached
Stage is Closed Lost and Loss Reason is blank
Amount is greater than zero
The Opportunity owner is not Tom Baptiste
questions.explain: The error condition is AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Loss_Reason__c))) -- it only fires on that one stage.

questions.q: What new field does this lesson add to Opportunity to make Rule 2 (the Decision Maker rule) possible?
options: Decision_Maker__c, a checkbox
Primary_Contact__c, a Lookup relationship to Contact
Loss_Reason__c, a picklist
Target_Install_Quarter__c, a picklist
questions.explain: Primary_Contact__c is added as a new Lookup field on Opportunity so a cross-object formula can reach the related Contact's Decision_Maker__c checkbox.

questions.q: Why does the formula use `Primary_Contact__r.Decision_Maker__c` instead of `Primary_Contact__c.Decision_Maker__c`?
options: Both forms work identically in Salesforce formulas
The `__r` suffix is the relationship name Salesforce generates for traversing a lookup field to a related record's fields in a formula
`__c` fields cannot be referenced in validation rules at all
`__r` is required only for Master-Detail relationships, never Lookups
questions.explain: The lesson explains that `__r` is the relationship name used to reach across from Opportunity into a field on the related Contact record; `__c` alone refers to the field holding the ID, not the related record.

questions.q: What does the Target_Install_Date_Not_Past rule check?
options: That Target Install Date is blank
That Target Install Date falls on a weekend
That Target Install Date is not earlier than today
That Target Install Date matches the Opportunity's Close Date
questions.explain: The rule's error condition is Target_Install_Date__c < TODAY(), blocking any date that has already passed.

questions.q: What does the Annual_Value_Positive rule on Service Contract enforce?
options: Annual Value must be greater than zero
Annual Value must match the Opportunity Amount exactly
Annual Value must be a whole number
Annual Value can only be set by Angela Wu
questions.explain: The error condition is Annual_Value__c <= 0, which blocks a zero or negative value before it ever reaches a renewal report.
